questions.question: The new policy _____ implemented next quarter to reduce operational costs.
questions.explanation: Future passive: 'will be implemented'. The policy hasn't happened yet (next quarter).

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ aware of the schedule change.
questions.explanation: Neither...nor: verb agrees with the nearest subject (employees = plural → were).

questions.question: The report, _____ was submitted last Friday, included several recommendations.
questions.explanation: 'which' is used for things (report). 'who' is for people.

questions.question: Employees are encouraged _____ their concerns to the HR department directly.
questions.explanation: 'encouraged to + infinitive' is the correct structure.

questions.question: The statistics _____ that customer satisfaction has improved significantly this year.
The company's quarterly earnings _____ all analyst expectations.
questions.explanation: 'Surpassed' = exceeded/went beyond. Fits earnings beating expectations.

questions.question: Please ensure that all documents are filed in _____ order for easy retrieval.
The CEO gave a _____ speech that motivated the entire workforce.
The new branch will _____ serve customers in the northern region.
Staff members should _____ their vacation requests at least two weeks in advance.
questions.explanation: 'Submit requests' is the correct collocation for a formal request.

questions.question: The conference will be held _____ March 15 and 17.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for two specific points (March 15 and 17).

questions.question: _____ the heavy rain, the outdoor event continued as planned.
The new software is compatible _____ all major operating systems.
questions.explanation: 'Compatible with' is the fixed preposition collocation.

questions.question: Applications must be received _____ 5:00 PM on the closing date.
The budget was revised _____ unexpected expenses arose mid-year.
questions.explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason/cause for the revision.
